title: Transfer Training Compliance Renewal Audit
goal: Compare archived PDF training-completion rosters against the current Excel compliance tracker to identify employees dropped from tracking, certification status regressions, and renewal-date mismatches.
skillBenefitRationale: 将 PDF 表格抽取与 XLSX 记录分析迁移到培训合规场景，重点测试日期、状态字段和员工主键的稳健比对能力。
